channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Killian Hayes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Killian Hayes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Killian Hayes:

“Having a traditional backup point guard is good for us... This10 days is important not just for him but also for us if he can do the things we're asking him to do. But we know who he is; thats the reason we brought him in the first place.”

Jordi Fernandez on Killian Hayes, Feb 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Haliburton said, mimicking his agent's motion.

“And then it flashed up, Killian Hayes, and I was like, 'What!?' In that moment I was frustrated, but I knew the Kings were my floor. But, still in the moment, I was just angry. I was like, 'What do you mean? They need a point guard and they're not picking me?' So that one definitely felt the most personal.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Killian Hayes, Feb 19, 2024. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Weaver on releasing Killian:

“It was a numbers game. With the trades, we had to take in a certain amount of players. There was an amount of players we had to release, and Killian got caught in that … tremendous young man and still 22. Hopefully he can carry on his career.”

Troy Weaver on Killian Hayes, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Monty on Hayes:

“He had some good moments with us. Sass was playing at a pretty good clip and then Monte came back, and I wanted to try some new things …I think he would agree he had a great opportunity here and I wish him the best.”

Monty Williams on Killian Hayes, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Killian Hayes, Marcus Sasser, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Monty on expectations for Ivey/Hayes/Sasser:

“I expect our guys to step up & try to win the game. This is not an opportunity to just go out & jack up shots because Cade's not out there & this is X amount of shots to be spread around. I want our guys to play winning basketball.”

Monty Williams on Killian Hayes, Marcus Sasser, Jaden Ivey, Jan 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Monty on Killian:

“I just think he’s growing as a young guard and understanding how we’re playing. He’s playing downhill, he’s getting to the basket, he’s playing in midrange and he’s also seeing the floor.”

Monty Williams on Killian Hayes, Dec 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“He's pressing a bit. He's overthinking things with his shooting. If he plays defense, that's good enough for us. He's just gotta find some joy in playing again.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Feb 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Cory Joseph on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsCory Joseph on Killian Hayes' development:

“What I have liked about Kill, is that you can see his mental has changed in how aggressive he's been... he's starting to figure it out, in terms of how to play in this league.”

Cory Joseph on Killian Hayes, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“Really, he's a rookie. He played 25 games last year, so he's basically a rookie. (Tonight) is the growth we expect from him.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Feb 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey:

“Killian's only played 20 more games than Cade. It's not like he's a grizzled veteran ...we're patient and giving him grace and continuing to work with him because he has skills. He sees the floor, he's big, he's strong and like anyone else, the shooting is going to come.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Jan 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes finding his niche:

“When you're in a corner, that's prime real estate... When a coach puts you in the corner, that's a sign of respect.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Dec 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Casey on Killian's hand:

“He could have played last night. It was one of those situations where Cory was playing a great game.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Nov 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“A rookie point guard in this league is like a rookie quarterback -- you have a lot going through your mind. It's easier said than done for a young player in this league.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Oct 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“He went through the whole practice today and he's back healthy. He's over the concussion he had, so we'll see tomorrow night...it'll be a great start for all of us.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Oct 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“I call him and Cade guards more so than point guard or 2-guard.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Oct 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsCade Cunningham on fit with Killian Hayes:

“We're on the same page mentally ... now, it's about finding a feel for each other. We have so much time to build on this and grow from it.”

Cade Cunningham on Killian Hayes, Aug 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Saddiq Bey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
James Edwards III:Saddiq Bey on Killian:

“His vision and feel for the game is outstanding, for anyone that matter, let alone his age. I enjoy playing with him out there.”

Saddiq Bey on Killian Hayes, May 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Killian Hayes' shooting:

“We want to let (his shot) come; we don't want to force it... if the game presents (opportunity), he has a green light to take it.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Apr 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“He had a chance to slow down and observe everything and watch what we do in practice and in film ... in a crazy way, he should benefit from that too.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Mar 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes' return:

“I probably put him at a disadvantage by starting him from the start ... we want to bring him along slowly, whether it's with the second group or with another point guard.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Mar 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
James Edwards III:Casey on how Killian Hayes has stayed engaged:

“No. 1 thing, we do a lot of our pregame meetings on zoom. He's involved in that and the gameplan.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Mar 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“Our goal is to get him up to speed going into the future.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Mar 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes progression:

“It's going solid. He's moving, he's shooting. Hopefully sometime in the next month, don't hold me to that ... he's coming right along.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Feb 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“He's been working and watching a lot of video in our team meetings...he's still engaged from that standpoint.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Feb 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Troy Weaver on Killian Hayes' injury:

“It’s a gut punch for the kid, because he wants to be successful like any other rookie and now that progress has to be slowed down and he has to make sure he takes care of his business and his injury.”

Troy Weaver on Killian Hayes, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Derrick Rose, Delon Wright, Killian Hayes, Saben Lee
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Jerami Grant on Hayes/Rose injuries and relying on Delon Wright and Saben Lee:

“It's definitely tough, but they're ready; they put a lot of work in.”

Jerami Grant on Derrick Rose, Delon Wright, Killian Hayes, Saben Lee, Jan 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes:

“I talked to him last night. His parents are around. He was in as good of spirits as you can be in while being injured.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Jan 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Killian Hayes
item.description:
James Edwards III:Derrick Rose on Killian Hayes' start and getting adjusted:

“It's really not fair. I played Summer League, which I did terrible in, but I was able to play those games. I played on the US Select team ... it gave me confidence.”

Derrick Rose on Killian Hayes, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes' pregame jitters:

“This is a baptism time for him -- and I'm excited for him... I'm sure there's some anxiety and nerves.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Dec 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Saddiq Bey, Russell Westbrook, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on potential matchups with #Wizards Beal and Westbrook for young players:

“It'll give a good feel for what Killian, Saben and Saddiq have to look forward to. It's a good test for us.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Saddiq Bey, Russell Westbrook, Bradley Beal, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.
